nasa_apod.explanation: What does it feel like to zoom around a spinning supermassive black hole?   The featured video is an animation showing a time-lapse of 4 years of observations of the star S301 orbiting Sagittarius A*, the 4-million-solar-mass black hole in the center of our Galaxy.
